repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
I'd like to log errors and exceptions to [errbit](https://github.com/errbit/errbit).
Yii 1 had onError and onException events. Yii 2 does not. I have to extend both \yii\web\ErrorHandler and \yii\console\ErrorHandler, and override the logException method to send the exception to errbit. It'd be more convenient if I could just attach a behavior to handle an event to both error handlers.

body:
the problem in this case seems to be that the exception includes a stack trace of the point where it was created. This stack trace also contains pointers to all the object references of functions being called and also their arguments. If this contains a closure at some point (which it does), the var_export here is going to fail: https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/a2e3e3b2576a162b7f2ad1627c2d1392d09fb3ce/framework/helpers/BaseVarDumper.php#L183
The fallback then fails because of a circular reference.
